It is everything you've dreamed of. It is nothing you expect.

But Danielle's life takes a wonderful turn when, under the guise of a visiting royal, she meets the charming Prince Henry.

They're here to save the planet. But not for free.
Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivruski IV (voice)

One curse, one cure, one week to find it.
2188: The trademark of The Phantom, a renowned jewel thief, is a glove left at the scene of the crime. You only live once… so see the Pink Panther twice!!!

It isn't love that makes the world go round.
2956: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.
He's not Freddy, he's not Jason...he's real.
3212: In 1950s Ireland and New York, young Eilis Lacey has to choose between two men and two countries.
Two countries, two loves, one heart
3468: England, 1600. Queen Elizabeth I promises Orlando, a young nobleman obsessed with poetry, that she will grant him land and fortune if he agrees to satisfy a very particular request.
3724: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private join forces with undercover organization The North Wind to stop the villainous Dr. Octavius Brine from destroying the world as we know it.
The movie event that will blow their cover.
3980: A recently slain cop joins a team of undead police officers working for the Rest in Peace Department and tries to find the man who murdered him.
To protect and serve the living.
4492: An indifferent hitman, his infatuated business partner and an ex-convict search for love and meaning as their lives cross paths in Hong Kong.
4748: A young man turns from drug addiction and petty crime to a life redeemed by a discovery of compassion.

In this world... Redemption comes just once.

In a time of revolution, in a family torn by tradition, one man was consumed by love.
6028: Three sisters try to come to grips with the meaning of their mother's suicide.
Meg just left one. Lenny never had one. Babe just shot one. The MaGrath sisters sure have a way with men.

Don't laugh little girl, better run for your life. The man you were talking to, has just murdered his wife!

6796: After completing jail time for beating up a man who tried to seduce his mentally-handicapped teenage daughter, the Butcher wants to start life anew. He whips out his sword and relieves his victims of their heads!!
7308: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.
Some icons are meant to fly.
7564: In the year 1935, a teen named Billy Bathgate finds first love while becoming the protégé of fledgling gangster Dutch Schultz.
In 1935, a New York kid was looking for a hero. He found Dutch Schultz.

9100: Andrea, a gifted young Polish violinist from Krakow, is bound for America when he is swept overboard by a storm. The story of two sisters who saved a stranger, and the stranger who stole their hearts.
9356: A documentary about the legendary series of nationally televised debates in 1968 between two great public intellectuals, the liberal Gore Vidal and the conservative William F. Buckley vs. Vidal. 2 Men. 10 Debates. Television Would Never Be the Same.

Writing A Book Is Easy. Writing A Best Seller Is Murder.

After that summer nothing would be the same.

It's never too late to risk it all.

The Intersection Where Family, Honor and Betrayal Collide.

He'll risk everything to beat the system.

In the loosest sense he is her husband. . .and in the loosest way she is his wife!

13452: A man looking for the release of a long-time prisoner takes a police officer, his daughter, and a group of strangers hostage.

Compared to them, the MacBeths were just plain folks and the Borgias were a nice Italian family.

17804: A bored wife leaves her husband for an unemployed, petty criminal.

Best friends and boyfriends, which one will you choose?

12 unique lives. 12 different stories will bring them all together.

Big dreams need a little magic

Meet Linda Liddle... She's from strategy and planning. She's the boss now.

Hunted by Iran. Abandoned by Israel. Deserted by India.

Do not look in her eyes.

The fateful entanglements of two men in love with the same woman.

Live by a code. Die by a bullet.

28812: A pregnant woman and her husband are taken in by a farmer and his wife after crashing their car in the Scottish countryside. Once inside, they realize their hosts’ daughter is a missing child from the news years earlier. Things take a sinister twist when the farmer and his wife inform the couple they intend to keep their baby once born.
She wants the life you give
29068: After federal agent Cleopatra Jones orders the burning of a Turkish poppy field, the notorious drug lord Mommy vows to destroy her.
6 feet 2" and all of it Dynamite!
29324: A powerful swordsman known as Deathstalker recovers a cursed amulet from a corpse-strewn battlefield. Marked by dark magic and hunted by monstrous assassins, he must face the rising evil and break the curse.
Evil has many names. Adventure has only one...

Unfortunately, new friends, a new job, and the chance of a new life, can’t keep Ellie from slipping once again. Her life changes when she meets Christopher – a different kind of addict – which forces her daughter and son to accept a new version of Ellie.

Hear the voices that power could not silence.

We don't choose our relatives. Neither can we choose a great love.
30860: A journalist finds himself on the trail of a murderer who's been targeting people around him, while the police are considering him a suspect in their investigation.
31116: Nina, a former NATO special operations agent living in hiding, has to use all her deadly skills to rescue her son who has been kidnapped by ruthless gangsters. 31372: A group of friends travel to a cabin in the Norwegian forest. It's a rumour that at night a crazy man can be heard screaming at a lake nearby the cabin.

Mankind's first fantastic flight to Venus - the female planet!

After multiple rendezvous, Perica's father becomes aware of Fulir's attempts to seduce his wife.
32140: A sub-inspector trainee sets out on a journey to track an unsolved, 16-year-old case. But little does he know that fate and destiny will put him on an exhilarating ride.
32396: Hardened by years in foster care, a teenage girl from Brooklyn’s Brownsville neighborhood decides that wrestling boys is the only way back to her estranged father.
32652: A group of American executives making a film about World War II decide that since their lead is rather unglamorous, they will draft in an American G.I. to play the part of Winston Churchill. EXORCISM! The one last hope for the possessed … But this time the devil wins!

Their interests were worlds apart but strange events brought them close together

The brave are never different - only different looking!
